core_obligations: Describe irreducible representation components as finite sign-group orbits across all allowed dimensions.
Combine component counts with their parabolic-Higgs moduli Euler characteristics.
Compare the result to Hamm monodromy eigenvalue multiplicities for Brieskorn-Hamm complete intersections.
proof_roadmap: Representation orbit counts by elementary symmetric polynomials
Euler characteristics of all moduli components
Hamm characteristic polynomial yields the same Milnor-number sum
difficulty_reason: The proof relates a sheaf-theoretic three-manifold invariant to a complete-intersection Milnor number by matching representation-space component strata with monodromy eigenvalue multiplicities. It requires the orbit structure in every possible component dimension and the Euler characteristics of the relevant Higgs moduli components; it is independent of the q-series reduction formulas.
